PluginData.Tooltip: 0.4.0 diagnostic: Custom Data tags + vanilla MyInventory.TransferByUser path, one exact 1 kg request.
PluginData.Description:
One-shot client plugin for Keen multiplayer server-authority testing.
Setup: - Put [IceSource] in the Custom Data of one or more cargo containers. Block names do not matter. - At least one tagged cargo must contain 1 kg or more of Ice. - Put [IceTest] in the Custom Data of one or more O2/H2 Generators. Block names do not matter. - Keep the blocks on the grid you are actively controlling from a cockpit or control seat. - Keep the selected generator OFF during the diagnostic so it does not consume the test Ice. - The plugin disables Use Conveyor and Auto-Refill on the selected target. - Version 0.4.0 does NOT call IMyInventory.TransferItemTo. It invokes the public Sandbox.Game.MyInventory.TransferByUser path used for user-initiated inventory transfers. - It requests exactly 1 kg once, then verifies source and target after 2 seconds and 5 seconds. - The log reports SERVER ACCEPTED, SERVER NOT CONFIRMED, AMBIGUOUS, or a TransferByUser reflection error. - Diagnostics are written to %APPDATA%\SpaceEngineers\IcePulseTest.log.
This remains a narrow one-shot diagnostic. The server remains authoritative.
